_comment: Alvos da coleta agendada (scripts/run_collection.py). Só URLs fixas e oficiais — a coleta agendada nunca usa busca (find_review_text/find_provider_info), porque uma busca pode achar o alvo errado sem ninguém revisando. Cada URL foi conferida manualmente antes de entrar aqui: veja README > Data quality > Scheduled collection.
_excluded_models_comment: sora-2: product discontinued per its own source page (Apr 2026) — needs a human decision, not an automated overwrite. luma-ray-3.2: the only fal.ai page found is 'Luma Ray 2' (different version) — the verifier correctly rejects it every time, so it's left out to avoid daily noise until a real Ray 3.2 source is found. minimax-hailuo-2.3: its fal.ai page prices per VIDEO ($0.49), never per second, so no field can ever be verified from it; meanwhile the LLM sometimes names it 'Hailuo 2.3' and the whole run went red (fixed by tolerating a dropped brand, but there is still nothing to gain from collecting it).
_excluded_providers_comment: replicate: its status page has no uptime percentage (incident days only), so every run would just log a rejection for nothing — left out until Replicate publishes one. together-ai: the status page lists uptime per hosted MODEL, not a platform-level component, and our 'use the lowest one' rule then picks a different model's number every run — technically verifiable (real quote, real number) but not a stable reliability signal. Left out until a per-model-list-averaging rule is built in code (see README > Data quality).
